question: Does compact full-MLP training close the matched QK-only dense-MLP parent's 124M/0.5-TPP loss once discarded ambient Muon direction is carried in the production-admitted 7.53125-bit temporal state?

theory.finite_state: two pair-VQ stages plus a fast Cartesian stage on c_fc, and one pair-VQ plus fast Cartesian stage on c_proj, supply the materialized MLP weights
theory.temporal_state: B32 signed-FHT, q7 base codes, one q8 high bit on the highest-error 25% of blocks, packed selectors, and one q8 gain per block carry projection error across updates
theory.causal_change: The earlier matched endpoint failed after fast code changes froze and late projected-update recovery fell near 0.10. The new state preserves more than 0.99975 of live discarded-feedback energy without a dense residual tensor.
theory.attention_control: Only QK is mapped; V and attention output projection remain dense, so this endpoint isolates complete MLP replacement rather than claiming complete model replacement.

run.reuse_parent: The prior parent is immutable and uses the identical model/data/evaluation seeds and fixed evaluation indices, so it is not rerun.

decision_policy.pass: Seal the endpoint and analyze the residual <=0.05 gap before deciding whether a longer 124M rung is warranted; do not automatically scale the model.
decision_policy.fail_loss_but_pass_direction: The temporal-direction problem is closed but finite pair-VQ function capacity or optimization remains limiting; return to the compact weight chart rather than changing this feedback codec.
decision_policy.fail_direction: Reject production temporal closure and diagnose the first refresh where the frozen carry gate breaks; do not loosen thresholds or sweep LR.

monitoring.terminal_action: Verify terminal artifacts and fixed losses, seal hashes and gate outcomes in the active project note, then continue only with the causally authorized full-MLP successor.
monitoring.error_action: Inspect process, status, log, GPU, and storage; recover or requeue only if scientifically justified, record the remediation, and continue.
